The graph of $y=f(x)$ is shown below. Sketch the graph of $y=f(-x).$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14224557/assets/cafc696543afde5d9e9d6442fa7f5634269ef836d94de40dcac598611be48b8c.png)
question.worked_solution:
To obtain the graph of $y=f(-x)$ from $y=f(x),$ we need to reflect the graph over the $y$-axis. The resulting graph is shown below.
